title: Issue Register Schema (CSV as JSON Array)
description: Structured issue list from governance audit. Each row represents one finding requiring action or attention. Produced by Layer 2 (DMA Governance) in Workflow A, Step 6.

issue_id.description: Unique issue identifier within this audit

run_id.description: References the DMA assessment run being audited

check_source.description: Which audit workflow step and check discovered this issue

affected_element.description: Which scorecard row, sheet, or component is affected

finding_description.description: Detailed description of what is wrong
examples: P2C3 score 3.2 flagged: rationale contains only 2 evidence links (E12, E18) but G3 check detected 5 evidence items reference this subcap (E12, E18, E45, E67, E89). Three evidence items not cited.
Proof structure incomplete for P1C2: rationale missing Rule links. Claims present (C1-C3), Evidence links present (E23:F2), but RuleID field empty.
Critic finding CRI-P3C1-002 flagged: 'Fraud automation claim unsupported by evidence tier' — remains in Critic_Log but no resolution documented in rationale.

root_cause.description: Analysis of why this issue exists
examples: Scorer focused on two highest-ERS evidence items and missed lower-tier corroborating evidence during evidence mapping
Proof template was incomplete in skill reference materials; scorer unaware of Rule link requirement
Critic tool flagged concern but scorer deferred resolution without documenting decision rationale

fix_instructions.description: Step-by-step fix instructions for Layer 1 re-run or manual correction
examples: Re-score P2C3: Map all 5 evidence items to rationale. Update Evidence_IDs cell to: E12:F2, E18:F3, E45:F1, E67:F4, E89:F5. Update rationale to cite all items per communication_standards.md
Update P1C2 rationale: Add Rule link field with RuleID = 'RULE_M3_GOVERNANCE_STRUCTURE' (from governance_criteria.md, line 247). Verify rule correctly applied to evidence.

Review Critic finding CRI-P3C1-002 in Critic_Log. Document resolution in P3C1 rationale: either (a) acknowledge concern and cite additional evidence, (b) refute with specific evidence, or (c) accept limitation with documented reasoning.

reference_docs.description: Relevant skill reference documents or schema URLs

linked_issues.description: Other issues (issue_ids) related to this one

resolution_date.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of issue resolution (if status = FIXED)
